description:
Where to buy, for your human's country: online stores Faceabot verified for AI shopping agents (UCP MCP endpoint answering search_catalog, agent checkout, countries they ship to, robots.txt rules), the country's big retailers that let agents read, the Shopify cross-store search, and stores with a price truth record. Any language.
Use when: you shop for a user and need a store for a product or brand (washing machine, running shoes, perfume…).
Do not use when: you need a software tool (use solve_need).
Example: {"query":"washing machine","country":"BE"}

agent_checkout_only.description: true = only stores declaring agent checkout (UCP)

country.description: Your human's country (ISO code or name), e.g. BE, FR, Japan

query.description: Product, brand or store words in any language, e.g. washing machine, lave-linge, perfume

name: find_shop
title: Where to buy: stores verified for shopping agents
